Public legal and support pages for **split**, a bill-splitting app for Georgia.

- [Privacy Policy](https://djamesg72.github.io/splitapp-legal/privacy.html) · [ქართულად](https://djamesg72.github.io/splitapp-legal/privacy.ka.html)
- [Terms & Conditions](https://djamesg72.github.io/splitapp-legal/terms.html) · [ქართულად](https://djamesg72.github.io/splitapp-legal/terms.ka.html)
- [Delete your account and data](https://djamesg72.github.io/splitapp-legal/delete-account.html)

## Do not edit these files here

They are generated from the markdown in the private app repo by
`tools/build_legal_site.py`. Edit `docs/legal/*.md` there, re-run the generator,
and copy `site/` over — otherwise the published pages drift from the source of
truth, and the policy that users read stops matching the policy of record.

Contact: splitapp.support@gmail.com
